report.summary: The investigation identified a clear issue in the payments service, primarily driven by connection pool exhaustion. The p95 latency alert (ALR-001) and high database pool utilization metrics (peaking at 30.2% in MET-00023 and MET-00230) strongly support this conclusion. Logs from the payments service (e.g., LOG-00762, LOG-00784, LOG-00813) confirm timeouts and connection acquisition failures, directly correlating with the observed performance degradation. No evidence of deployment-related errors or misconfigurations was found, ruling out bad_deployment as a primary cause. The orders service is indirectly affected due to its dependency on payments (DEP-004), but the root cause remains localized to the payments service.
